head: apgi-cmy-minimal-ecap-foundation
objective: Minimal static, administrative-only bootstrap foundation for execution-ceremony-admin-agent.
exclusions: No reusable Foreman appointment path or template.
No runtime, controller, workflow, canon, consumer, ISMS, product, or MMM change.
